## Release Notes

Add one validated fragment under `release-notes/` for every user-facing
behavior, security, operational, or documentation change. The body should
describe the impact to people using or operating Tunerr. See
[`release-notes/README.md`](../release-notes/README.md) for the required fields
and preview command.
